Moved.description: One representation of the from revision and the one the move wrote for it in the new revision.

from.description: A representation id of the from revision, e.g. curve:<key>; its row is never written by the move
from.title: From

to.description: The representation id the move wrote in the new revision, e.g. well-log-curve:<key>
to.title: To

to_sha256.description: SHA-256 of that new stored representation
to_sha256.title: To Sha256

Moved.title: Moved

description:
E183 s1b: one stored item's representations moved under one registered mapping to another profile as a new
revision; the from revision's rows are kept as they were; never changed.

asset_id.description: The logical item; both revisions are versions of it
asset_id.title: Asset Id

from_revision.description: The item's head revision when the move started; its rows are never written by the move
from_revision.title: From Revision

from_profile.description: The profile of every representation moved from
from_profile.title: From Profile

to_profile.description: The profile of every representation written, never the from profile
to_profile.title: To Profile

to_revision.description: The new revision the move wrote; the to of at most one record
to_revision.title: To Revision

mapping.description: The registered mapping document from the from profile to the to profile
mapping.title: Mapping

representations.description: Each representation moved, in the order written; from and to unique
representations.title: Representations

release.description: The release that ran the move; null when the deployment names none
